metadata.description: Customer segment analysis investigating declining order values in specific market segments

turns.content: Our marketing team noticed that average order values have been declining. Can you investigate by customer segment?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing AOV by market segment

turns.content: What customer segments do we have in our data?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should return C_MKTSEGMENT values

turns.content: Show me the average order value by market segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate AVG(O_TOTALPRICE) by segment

turns.content: For this analysis, only include orders from 1995 onwards.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to 1995+ orders

turns.content: AUTOMOBILE segment has the highest AOV. Let me see the trend over time — show me monthly AOV by segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show monthly AOV trends by segment

turns.content: HOUSEHOLD segment shows declining AOV. When I say order date, I mean O_ORDERDATE column specifically.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Let me focus on HOUSEHOLD segment. Show me order distribution by total price ranges.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should bucket orders by price ranges

turns.content: There are fewer high-value orders. Show me customers in HOUSEHOLD segment who have reduced their spending.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare customer spending over time

turns.content: Which regions are these declining HOUSEHOLD customers from?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show regional distribution of declining customers

turns.content: Exclude ASIA region from this analysis — we're already investigating that separately.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out ASIA region

turns.content: Show me the top HOUSEHOLD customers outside ASIA and their order history.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customer order history

turns.content: Let me see the product categories these declining customers used to order.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show product types ordered by declining customers

turns.content: Are these customers still ordering but buying cheaper products?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare order values and product mix over time

turns.content: Some customers stopped ordering entirely. How many HOUSEHOLD customers from 1994 haven't ordered in 1995?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify churned customers

turns.content: What's the total revenue we lost from these churned HOUSEHOLD customers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum revenue from churned customers

turns.content: Let me check if there's a pattern with order priorities. Show me the order priority distribution for HOUSEHOLD segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show O_ORDERPRIORITY distribution

turns.content: Are there specific nations where HOUSEHOLD customers have churned more?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show churn by nation for HOUSEHOLD segment

turns.content: Remember when we looked at monthly AOV by segment? Can you show me that again but only for HOUSEHOLD and AUTOMOBILE?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: Remember when we looked at monthly AOV by segment?
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recreate monthly AOV for HOUSEHOLD and AUTOMOBILE

turns.content: Let me compare with BUILDING segment. Show me BUILDING customers who increased their spending.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customers with increasing spending in BUILDING

turns.content: What products are these growing BUILDING customers ordering?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show product mix for growing BUILDING customers

turns.content: Interesting — they're ordering different product types. Let me see if HOUSEHOLD customers who stayed also shifted their product mix.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare product mix of retained HOUSEHOLD customers over time

turns.content: What was the average order value for HOUSEHOLD in January 1995?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall or recalculate January AOV for HOUSEHOLD

turns.content: Let me check if this correlates with order size. Show me line item counts per order for HOUSEHOLD segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show distribution of items per order

turns.content: Orders are getting smaller in terms of items. What about discount levels?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze discount trends

turns.content: Higher discounts in recent months. Show me the correlation between discount and order value.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show relationship between discount and order size

turns.content: Apply all the filters we've established and show me a summary by segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: 1995+, O_ORDERDATE, exclude ASIA

turns.content: What's driving the HOUSEHOLD decline specifically?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should summarize findings

turns.content: Let me see the customer lifetime value for HOUSEHOLD customers who churned vs those who stayed.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare total revenue between churned and retained

turns.content: Show me the acquisition date distribution for HOUSEHOLD customers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show when customers first ordered

turns.content: Many churned customers were acquired in 1994. What was different about 1994 acquisition?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze 1994 customer acquisition patterns

turns.content: Let me see which acquisition channels (nations) had the worst retention.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show retention by nation

turns.content: Can you create a chart showing customer segments by order value distribution?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create visualization

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: 1995+, use O_ORDERDATE, exclude ASIA

turns.content: Good. Show me top 20 HOUSEHOLD customers by total order value with all filters applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customer ranking with all filters

turns.content: Earlier we identified that HOUSEHOLD customers in AMERICA region were churning. Can you verify that?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall nation churn analysis

turns.content: Create a final report showing HOUSEHOLD segment performance metrics.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should summarize HOUSEHOLD analysis

turns.content: Let me also compare with MACHINERY segment trends.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show MACHINERY segment analysis

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that HOUSEHOLD segment decline is driven by customer churn, particularly those acquired in 1994, and they're not being replaced by new customers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and summarize findings

persistedCorrections.description: Always use O_ORDERDATE column for order dates

anaphoricReferences.phrase: Remember when we looked at monthly AOV by segment?
anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Monthly AOV breakdown by segment from turn 5
